_meta.anthropic/searchHint: cheapest day to fly flight price calendar month

description: Cheapest known fare for each day of a month on one route: a price calendar to pick the cheapest day to fly. Example: {"origin":"DSS","destination":"LIS","month":"2026-12","currency":"EUR"}. Prices may be cached (priceKind indicative); confirm with search_flights before booking.

currency.description: ISO 4217 display currency. Default EUR. XOF is shown as FCFA.

destination.description: Arrival airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

origin.description: Departure airport or city: a 3-letter IATA airport/metro code (ABJ, DSS, LOS, CDG, LON, NYC) or a plain name ("Abidjan", "Paris").

name: find_cheapest_dates
title: Find cheapest dates
